edition: Rahlfs–Hanhart, second revised edition (2006), German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User authorized provisional continuation with Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006; Göttingen not obtained.
scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 is the user-authorized provisional base. The listed running-text passages were inspected selectively; this is not a complete Greek or apparatus collation. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing study/comparison records and three dagger notes were consulted as reference, not proof of a fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Ordinary address to Joshua uses you/your. The first you in 1:5 is plural; your life and the following address are singular. In 1:6 your fathers is plural amid singular address to Joshua. The two prosperity expressions in 1:8 and the shifts between your God and our God remain.
chapters.pending: Singular/plural address, apportionment terminology and the repeated prosperity clauses.

chapters.decision: Retain the Greek speaker change to Rahab in 2:14, the phrase part of the city in 2:18, and anyone in 2:20. The spies address Rahab in the singular in 2:17–20. The yours in their life pledge at 2:14 is plural, embracing those represented by Rahab.
chapters.pending: Oath syntax, the speaker change, household relationships and the referent of part of the city.

chapters.decision: Retain the repeated ark titles, the shift from you to us in 3:10, Kiriath-jearim, water singular/plural relationships and wheat harvest. Very, very far in 3:16 restores the doubled Greek intensifier.
chapters.pending: Water imagery, geography, the doubled intensifier and the temporal comparison in 3:15.

chapters.decision: Retain ready stones, another twelve stones, and the stones before them in 4:11. The singular your son and individual address in 4:6–7 differ from the plural your sons in 4:21–22; modern you does not display every number distinction.
chapters.pending: Ready stones, the 4:11 stones clause, and singular/plural changes in the memorial instructions.

chapters.decision: Retain forty-two years, Madbaritis, new grain and the Phoenician wording. The commander is addressed as Master with ordinary you/your; the English does not decide his identity through divine pronouns. The singular sandal and plural feet in 5:15 remain.
chapters.pending: Circumcision chronology and 5:4–7 syntax; identification of the commander and the force of his title.

chapters.decision: Keep the missing 6:4 label, six circuits in 6:15 followed by the seventh circuit in 6:16, Lord Sabaoth, and the Ozan/Abiram continuation at 6:26. The he himself wording at 6:10 is retained rather than silently changed to I.
chapters.pending: Plural force of mighty in 6:2, the speaker/referent in 6:10, ban terminology and 6:26 names.

chapters.decision: Joshua directly addresses God as Thee/Thy/Thou in 7:7–9. Retain Thy servant, Achar, the differing genealogical forms, didrachms, the tongue-shaped gold bar, and the singular object him in 7:25.
chapters.pending: Prayer syntax, carpet terminology, genealogy, the bar's weight, and the relationship of 7:24–26.

chapters.decision: Keep the gaps at 8:13 and 8:26, the shorter ambush account and the forked tree. With the javelin in 8:18 supplies the English connection in the inherited hand/javelin construction; it does not select a new textual reading.
chapters.pending: The hand/javelin construction, the terrain syntax in 8:24 and the forked tree.

chapters.decision: Keep the Mount Ebal passage at 9:2a–2f. Retain the Horite and Israel's collective singular my/I in 9:7. Joshua is addressed with your, including Your servants in 9:9. Keep the slave/woodcutter wording at 9:23.
chapters.pending: The second law expression, source arrangement, collective singular address and covenant-service terms.

chapters.decision: Retain Adoni-bezek, the Jebusite kings, the missing 10:15 label and the Greek form of the sun/moon account. For a full day gives natural English to the temporal expression in 10:13. In 10:8 your hands is singular address to Joshua, while before you is plural.
chapters.pending: Names, collective subjects, the sun/moon temporal expression and the conquest summary.

chapters.decision: Smooth ordinary address while retaining the inherited names, earthworks, strengthened hearts, repeated destruction wording and the distinct whole stock of Israel phrase.
chapters.pending: Place names, earthworks, stock of Israel in 11:21 and the pronoun/reference in 11:23.

chapters.decision: Retain twenty-nine kings and the shorter list. One of the remaining giants makes the inherited description of Og easier to follow without replacing giants or changing the count.
chapters.pending: Every royal name, geographical boundary and the list's total against the apparatus.

chapters.decision: Use you/your for God's address to Joshua. Retain the five satrapies, the Great Sea boundary, repeated land grants, the source's allocations and the repeated beyond the Jordan in 13:32.
chapters.pending: Territorial names, 13:3–5 boundaries, the doubled Machir allocation at 13:31 and sentence relationships.

chapters.decision: Clarify the opening assignment sentence and Caleb's ordinary address. Keep his mind in 14:7 with its original dagger note; no antecedent is silently decided. Keep the shorter 14:2–3 construction and the repeated livestock wording in 14:4.
chapters.pending: The antecedent of his at 14:7, 14:2–4 syntax, genealogy and the mother-city expression.

chapters.decision: Modernize archaic movement verbs without renaming places. Restore future will pass/will end in the last sentence of 15:7. Preserve Golathmaim, the lettered Bethlehem-area list at 15:59a, city counts and until that day at 15:63.
chapters.pending: Full place-name and boundary collation, 15:7 fourth part, 15:17 relationship, Golathmaim and list totals.

chapters.decision: Retain the existing future boundary verbs, distinct place names and the Pharaoh/dowry continuation at 16:10. Existing English wording requires no change in this chapter.
chapters.pending: Place-name identification, border geography and the 16:10 continuation against the apparatus.

chapters.decision: Keep Anassa, Labek, the terebinth in 17:9 and choice cavalry and iron in 17:16. The sons of Joseph speak as a collective I/me at 17:14, and Joshua replies with singular address to that collective in 17:15, 17–18.
chapters.pending: Difficult geographic syntax, cavalry/iron terminology and the temporal relationship in 17:18.

chapters.decision: Smooth the surveying instruction while retaining its narrative parenthesis across 18:4–5, seven portions, and the existing boundary names and future forms.
chapters.pending: Surveying terminology, parenthetical sequence and every boundary name and direction.

chapters.decision: Retain the existing lists and all three Dan-section forms 19:47a, 48 and 48a. Judah, Lachish and Lasendak in 19:48 remain with their original dagger note. No familiar alternate conquest account is substituted.
chapters.pending: The major divergence at 19:48, all tribal/place-name lists, city counts and boundary syntax.

chapters.decision: Modernize strikes and stands. Keep the six-unit chapter with its gap at 20:4–6, involuntary killing, blood-avenging next of kin, and judgment before the congregation.
chapters.pending: Legal vocabulary, subject/reference in 20:7–8, and the shorter chapter form.

chapters.decision: Clarify the Merari total as a complete English sentence. Preserve all repeated allotted/surrounding lands phrases, city counts, and the Joshua/stone-knives addition at 21:42a–42d.
chapters.pending: The lands assigned at 21:11–12, singular city at 21:20, plural refuge cities at 21:27, names and totals.

chapters.decision: Keep mind and soul, the small-land condition, repeated God titles, third-person may He not deliver, repeated sacrificial categories, Joshua naming the altar, and salamin sacrifices at 22:29 with its existing dagger note. The fearful possibility at 22:24 is expressed as tomorrow your children might say.
chapters.pending: The 22:20 rhetorical question, 22:22 invocation, 22:24–28 speaker shifts, salamin and the altar-name wording.

chapters.decision: Use direct English commands while retaining wild beasts, the nails-in-heels/darts-in-eyes images, good and harmful words, and the land-gift clauses. Not one has proved untrue expresses the inherited non-variance clause in 23:14.
chapters.pending: The boundary construction at 23:4, the non-variance expression in 23:14 and covenant-warning syntax.

chapters.decision: Remove the accidental doubled out across 24:5–6 without moving the verse boundary. Restore them in 24:13 to refer to the plural cities. Preserve first/third-person and we/you shifts, twelve kings, future you shall eat, for He is holy, the heard-by-the-stone image, and all terminal additions. In 24:10 the initial you is collective singular, then plural; in 24:12 your sword/your bow are collective singular.
chapters.pending: Person shifts, twelve kings, the stone's testimony, all terminal additions, chronology and personal/place names.
